source_title: It: Welcome to Derry Drops Surprise Halloween Episode
source_excerpt:
HBO has jump-scared subscribers with a surprise episode of It: Welcome to Derry to help celebrate Halloween.
Log in to HBO Max now, and you'll see a one-off story in Pennywise's playground that no one saw coming headlining the streamer's new arrivals. Titled "A Story of Derry," the episode is only 30 minutes long and takes place hundreds of years before the events of Season 1, meaning you won't have to ditch any trick-or-treating or party prep to get the full picture.
You can read an official description for It: Welcome to Derry's A Story of Derry episode here: "Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood…where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit."
IT's a surprise Halloween treat. Catch this never-before-seen special exploring the origins of IT in Derry. #AStoryOfDerry is streaming now on HBO Max. 🎈 https://t.co/NH3NcMLt8n
It's the kind of shadow-drop Stranger Things fans can only dream of . Despite coming in at about half the length of Welcome to Derry's usual hour-long runtime, It fans will no doubt be happy to see any new content, considering there was no prior announcement that anything was in the works. After all, Season 1 came out just one year ago, and although Season 2 is greenlit , we probably won't get to see it until late 2027 at the earliest.
Still, that didn't stop hardcore Stephen King fans from speculating that a surprise episode was slated to drop sometime around Halloween. In the weeks leading up to today's maybe not-so-unexpected announcement, there were some rumors that HBO had secretly shot a bonus episode.
After Stranger Things left thousands of fans in the dark when their surprise finale episode theories didn't pan out, most Welcome to Derry watchers justifiably thought the rumors were nonsense. You can even see that hesitation in some of their comments.
"Completely fake," one fan said earlier this month.
"I’d be impressed they could keep a whole production with cast and crew under wraps in this day and age so doubting this but would be impressed to learn otherwise," another added .
Thrilljoy's IT: Welcome to Derry PIX! Figures - Image Gallery
Well, anyway, A Story of Derry was directed by Reservation Dogs and The Paper alum Tazbah Chavez. It was written by Welcome to Derry producer Cherie Dimaline and the show's writer and editor, Jasmyne Flournoy.
The episode serves as an early, early look at its world, which is something the minds behind the show have teased they've wanted to do for years. Season 1 was set before the events of Bill Skarsgård's Pennywise-led movies, with a story that took place during the Cold War, and Season 2 is expected to follow events from 1935, with the planned third season previously said to be set in 1908.
A Story of Derry turns back the clock earlier than anyone may have anticipated, and that only helps its surprise drop's shock factor. This is unlike anything It fans expected to see on Halloween today, but it'll almost certainly carve out some time in everyone's nights now. Meanwhile, the episode opens up with a bit more text about its premise. You can read it below:
"Generations ago, when the Kollu first preyed on our people, we left warnings for those who would come after. But we hid the truth inside a gentler tale, one our children could carry. This is the story we do not teach. This is the part we left out."
IGN gave It: Welcome to Derry Season 1's premiere an 8/10 and its finale a 7/10 . While we wait to see how A Story of Derry fits into King's big picture, you can read about how Season 1 connects to the author's multiverse here .
Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).
hi_body:
HBO ने हैलोवीन के मौके पर अपने दर्शकों को सरप्राइज देते हुए *It: Welcome to Derry* का एक नया 30-मिनट का एपिसोड "A Story of Derry" जारी किया है। यह विशेष एपिसोड एक स्टैंडअलोन कहानी है, जो पेनीवाइज (Pennywise) के दौर से सैकड़ों साल पहले की घटनाओं को दर्शाता है।

## एपिसोड की जानकारी
*   **अवधि:** लगभग 30 मिनट।
*   **कथानक:** यह तीन बच्चों की कहानी है जो पेनीवाइज के अस्तित्व में आने से सैकड़ों साल पहले वेस्टर्न वुड में जाते हैं और एक प्राचीन भयावह शक्ति का सामना करते हैं।
*   **क्रिएटिव टीम:** इसका निर्देशन तज़बाह शावेज़ (Tazbah Chavez) ने किया है और इसे चेरी डिमालिन और जैस्मीन फ्लोरनॉय ने लिखा है।

### पृष्ठभूमि और निर्माण
हालांकि स्टीफन किंग के प्रशंसकों के बीच एक गुप्त एपिसोड की चर्चा चल रही थी, लेकिन कई लोग इसे लेकर संशय में थे। "A Story of Derry" का यह सरप्राइज ड्रॉप श्रृंखला के सामान्य एक घंटे के एपिसोड से काफी अलग है। फिलहाल शो का दूसरा सीजन ग्रीनलाइट हो चुका है, लेकिन इसके 2027 के अंत से पहले आने की संभावना कम है। यह स्पेशल एपिसोड डैरी (Derry) के इतिहास और उस "कोल्लू" (Kollu) से जुड़ी कहानियों को उजागर करता है, जिनका उल्लेख निर्माता काफी समय से करते रहे हैं।

दर्शक HBO Max पर लॉग इन करके इस एपिसोड को देख सकते हैं। शो की उपलब्धता की जांच करने या इसे स्ट्रीम करने के लिए, सब्सक्राइबर्स को प्लेटफॉर्म पर *It: Welcome to Derry* के हब पर जाना होगा।
hi_title: HBO ने 'It: Welcome to Derry' का नया सरप्राइज हैलोवीन एपिसोड जारी किया
hi_meta: HBO ने हैलोवीन के लिए इट: वेलकम टू डैरी का एक नया 30-मिनट का स्पेशल एपिसोड 'अ स्टोरी ऑफ डैरी' जारी किया है जो अब स्ट्रीमिंग के लिए उपलब्ध है।
en_body:
HBO has released a surprise 30-minute episode of *It: Welcome to Derry* titled "A Story of Derry" to mark the Halloween season. The special acts as a standalone installment, exploring the origins of the franchise's antagonist long before the events depicted in previous seasons.

## Episode Details
*   **Runtime:** Approximately 30 minutes.
*   **Premise:** The narrative follows three youngsters who enter the Western Wood hundreds of years before Pennywise, where they encounter an ancient spirit.
*   **Creative Team:** Directed by Tazbah Chavez, with a script written by Cherie Dimaline and Jasmyne Flournoy.

### Context and Production
While rumors of a secret bonus episode had circulated among Stephen King fans, many viewers remained skeptical that such a production could be kept hidden. The surprise arrival of "A Story of Derry" marks a significant departure from the typical hour-long runtime of the series. While Season 2 is currently greenlit, it is not expected until at least late 2027. This special provides a deeper look into the history of Derry, exploring lore that producers have teased for years, specifically regarding the "Kollu" and the warnings left by previous generations.

Viewers can access the episode by logging into their HBO Max accounts. To verify availability or watch the content, subscribers should navigate to the *It: Welcome to Derry* hub on the streaming platform.
en_title: HBO Surprises Fans With New 'It: Welcome to Derry' Halloween Special
en_meta: HBO has surprised viewers with a new 30-minute special episode of It: Welcome to Derry titled A Story of Derry, now streaming for Halloween.
